label: prop:six-canonical-knot-operators
title: Six canonical knot operators as Reeb-flow trajectories ($S_3$ realisation)
html:
Proposition (conditional on def:q-reeb-flow-on-color-coords). Let \mathcal{R}_p be the Reeb bundle over the exceptional divisor at brane point p. For each of the six elements w \in S_3, the corresponding braid word \beta_w \in B_3 generates a unique trajectory across \mathcal{R}_p. Its boundary footprint realises w as a Galois permutation of the colour tubes.

The trajectory-by-trajectory construction of the six boundary permutations is given in the Reeb-bundle trajectory trace.
